title: Disaster Recovery Warm Standby Cluster Failover
precondition: Primary cloud region experiences catastrophic data center failure.
steps: 1. Trigger automated DNS and database failover to secondary cloud region.
expected: Standby MAM engine assumes active traffic within 120 seconds; zero dropped trades (RPO = 0s, RTO < 120s).
coverage_note: Requires operator/backoffice infrastructure, deployment/failover controls, immutable logs, or external clearing evidence not supplied.
